title: Letting AI Formulate the Research Question: Autonomous Research Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.39620v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Systems such as The AI Scientist have shown that AI agents can carry out and write up research, but in those demonstrations humans chose the research area and selected the outputs to show. We study letting the AI formulate the research question itself, and we report every run. Our system gives an off-the-shelf coding agent an instruction document and two skills: one for formulating the question, in which the agent diverges from recent technologies into problems of other fields, screens its candidates for known failure modes and obtains a critique from a different model; and one for peer review, in which a reviewer from another model family reruns the study from its records before the agent revises the paper. translated_title: 让AI自主提出研究问题：自主研究智能体
translated_abstract: 诸如The AI Scientist之类的系统已经证明，AI智能体能够开展研究并撰写论文，但在那些演示中，研究方向由人类选定，展示的成果也由人类挑选。我们研究了让AI自行提出研究问题，并报告了每一次运行的结果。我们的系统为现成的编程智能体提供了一份指令文档和两项技能：一项用于提出研究问题，智能体从近期技术出发发散到其他领域的问题，对候选问题进行已知失败模式的筛查，并从另一个模型获取批评意见；另一项用于同行评审，在该智能体修改论文之前，由来自另一模型家族的审稿人根据研究记录重新运行整个研究。在13次开发运行中，设定研究领域的一两句话发生改动时，候选问题和最终选定论文的主题也随之发生巨大变化，这引导我们进入了一项新技术所涉及的研究领域。
tldr: 该论文提出了让AI智能体自主提出研究问题（而非由人类指定研究方向）的自主研究系统，通过问题构思与跨模型同行评审两项技能实现全流程自主研究，并完整公开报告了全部13次开发运行结果。
en_tdlr: This paper presents autonomous research agents that let AI formulate its own research questions rather than having humans choose the research area, combining question-formulation and cross-model peer-review skills with fully reported results from all 13 development runs.
